items.title: For investors with ability to understand and take risks: 6 small-caps from different sectors with upside potential of up to 26%
items.description: The mood across global markets is not great at this point of time. News headlines point in directions we would rather they did not. But such is the reality of life. In the kind of bearish conditions we face today (and are likely to face for some time), understand one thing: The order book does not shorten because the screen turned red. In a pessimistic market, an investor who can make a distinction between a small-cap stock and a small-cap business stands to gain.
